# Debug striptags and unescape on escaped label
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-c', r'''
import markdown
from markdown.extensions.toc import striptags, unescape

raw_label = 'Foo \x02wzxhzdk:0\x03Quux\x02wzxhzdk:1\x03'
print(f"raw_label: {repr(raw_label)}")
print(f"striptags(raw_label): {repr(striptags(raw_label))}")
print(f"unescape(striptags(raw_label)): {repr(unescape(striptags(raw_label)))}")
'''],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='.'
)
print("STDOUT:", result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-200:])
